title: Frozen Walk-Forward Calibration Scorer and Venn-ABERS Ablation Ladder
summary: Adopted immutable frozen calibration evaluator (Brier, Log-Loss, Equal-Width/Equal-Mass ECE, inductive Venn-ABERS intervals, and Maurer-Pontil Empirical-Bernstein LCB with range width 2) and declarative JSON ablation ladder across 5 walk-forward slices.
provenance: Beexly/Sports Wave E (direct-to-mind trainer feed; single-writer brain/mind.jsonl preserved)

title: Stream 15P L-RAPM + Dummy-RAPM + Catalytic Shrinkage Positional Vulnerability Engine
summary: Strictly causal joint offense-player and 32-defense weighted Ridge decomposition over cleared CC-BY-4.0 nflverse 2025 and 2026 (week < as_of_week) across 5 skill families (qb_pass, rb_rush, rb_rec, wr_rec, te_rec) with Dummy-RAPM absorber rho=2.2 and catalytic shrinkage.

title: Stream 15Q Causal FTN x PBP Non-QB-Fault Pressure Survival Hazard
summary: Ridge IRLS decomposition of non-QB-fault OL pressure across 32 protections, 32 rushes, and 6 FTN covariates (blitz, 5+ rushers, play-action, motion, screen, blitz x PA) evaluated walk-forward across 2026 Weeks 4-10 (n=7,241 pass plays).
provenance: Beexly/Sports Wave F Cycle F2 (honesty invariant: null EPA sub-components held at 0.0 logit weight)

title: Strictly Sequential Gibbs-Candes Online ACI Ablation Rung 4
summary: Sequential Adaptive Conformal Inference (gamma=0.05) on top of Venn-ABERS dramatically reduced non-stationary OOS ECE across real_moneyline (0.147008->0.027185), real_spread (0.218491->0.072188), and real_total (0.175038->0.072331).

title: Stream 15R ISA Barometric Air Density, Wind & EB Kicker Survival Model
summary: Causal Ridge logistic FG hazard across 627 cleared 2026 PBP field-goal attempts and 32 stadium elevations; beat distance-only baseline across Weeks 4-10 (n=436) on Brier, Log-Loss, and ECE.

title: Stream 15S Causal Next Gen Stats CPOE, RYOE & Separation/YACOE
summary: Causal EB decomposition over cleared nflverse 2025-2026 NGS passing/receiving/rushing evaluated walk-forward across Weeks 4-10. QB CPOE (wMSE 0.065867 vs 0.073151, r=0.323) and RB RYOE (0.048352 vs 0.049399, r=0.142) promoted; WR/TE Sep+YACOE held at 0.0 weight vs league baseline.

title: Baker-McHale (2013) Parameter-Uncertainty Kelly Shrinkage
summary: Added baker_mchale_shrunk_kelly scaling Kelly stakes by mu^2 / (mu^2 + (d * sigma_p)^2) to eliminate overbetting under finite-sample probability estimation variance.
